column1: # Kernel.ObjectStateType: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;
# a removed or changed row needs a line in scripts/gates/objective-contract-changes.txt.

column8: ∀ (row : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty) (label : String) (member : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.caseOf row label = Option.some member → ∀ (payload : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.caseTyped row label payload = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt member payload

∀ (fields : List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data)) {key name : String}, key ≠ name → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.countField (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.withoutField fields key) name = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.countField fields name

∀ {bytes : Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Bytes} {type : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.decodeTyBytes bytes = Option.some type → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.tyBytes type = bytes

∀ (type : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty) (fuel : ℕ) (rest : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendCheckpoint.Tokens), List.length (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.encodeTy type) ≤ fuel → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.decodeTy fuel (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.encodeTy type ++ rest) = Option.some (type, rest)

∀ (fields : List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data)) {key name : String}, key ≠ name → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.lookupField (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.withoutField fields key) name = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.lookupField fields name

∀ (smaller : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty), (∀ (larger : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty) (value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.stateSubtype smaller larger = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt smaller value = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt larger value = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (row' : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty) (label : String) (payload : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.casesSub smaller row' = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.caseTyped smaller label payload = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.caseTyped row' label payload = Bool.true

∀ {smaller larger : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.stateSubtype smaller larger = Bool.true → ∀ {value : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data}, Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt smaller value = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt larger value = Bool.true

∀ (row : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty) (name : String) (member rest : Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendTypes.Ty), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.takeField row name = Option.some (member, rest) → ∀ (fields : List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data)), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt row (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.record fields) = ((Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.countField fields name == 1 && match Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.lookupField fields name with | Option.some value => Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt member value | Option.none => Bool.false) && Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.typedAt rest (Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data.record (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.withoutField fields name)))

∀ (fields : List (String × Minidregg.Theory.ObjectiveBendDemandData.Data)) (one two : String), Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.withoutField (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.withoutField fields one) two = Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.withoutField (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectStateType.withoutField fields two) one
